name: Grand Hyatt Kauai Resort & Spa
positioning: Low-rise, open-air beachfront resort on Poipu Beach on Kauai's sunny south shore, with lush gardens, a lazy river and Anara Spa
best_for: Families who want a lazy river, a waterslide and connecting rooms
Couples looking for spa time, a quiet adult pool area and a private beachside dinner
Golfers who want to play Poipu Bay Golf Course

facts.text: The resort sits on the white sands of Poipu Beach on Kauai's sunny south shore.
Conde Nast Traveler describes a low-rise resort on Keoneloa Bay with an open-air design that recalls the island glamour of the 1920s and '30s.
The hotel calls itself an eco-friendly beachfront resort with lush gardens and acres of pools.
Rooms have a private lanai, either a balcony or a walkout patio on the ground floor.
Conde Nast Traveler notes rain shower heads, Hawaiian-print linens and four-post mahogany beds.
The Royal Suite is just steps from the beach and sleeps six.
The pools include a quiet adult pool area.
Poipu Bay Golf Course, designed by Robert Trent Jones Jr., has 18 championship holes set between lush mountains and rugged ocean cliffs.
Poipu Bay Golf Course hosted the annual PGA Grand Slam of Golf from 1994 to 2006.
For a private dining experience, the resort offers a starlit beachside dinner for two.
Connecting rooms are offered for extra space.

highlights.text: A lava rock-lined lazy river flows past waterfalls, quiet seating nooks and secret caves, ending at a 150-foot waterslide.
Tidepools serves modern Island cuisine in thatched-roof bungalows floating above a koi-filled lagoon at the base of a waterfall.
Anara Spa weaves traditional healing customs to inspire lokahi, the balance and harmony of body and spirit.
Pool Suites overlook the multilevel pools and have a walk-in wet room, a double shower and a free-standing French tub.
Guests can attend a luau, tour the hydroponic garden or take hula, ukulele or lei-making classes at the resort.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes that the large resort property may feel less intimate.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
